recipes.title: Moussaka
recipes.blurb: Layers of eggplant, spiced lamb tomato sauce and creamy bechamel

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush eggplant slices with oil, season with salt and roast on sheet pans until golden.
Brown the lamb with the onion in a large skillet. Drain extra fat and stir in the garlic.
Add wine, tomatoes, tomato paste, cinnamon and oregano. Simmer until thick, then season well.
For the bechamel, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in warm milk until thick.
Off the heat, stir in half the cheese, then the eggs, with a little salt and pepper.
Lower the oven to 350°F. Layer half the eggplant, all the meat sauce, then the rest of the eggplant in a 9x13 dish.
Spread the bechamel on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbling and deep golden on top.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting so the layers set.

recipes.title: Spanakopita
recipes.blurb: Flaky phyllo pie filled with spinach and feta

steps.text: Thaw the phyllo in the fridge overnight. Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13 pan.
Soften the green onions in the olive oil for 3 minutes, then cool a little.
Mix the squeezed spinach, onions, dill, feta, cottage cheese, eggs, nutmeg and pepper.
Lay 10 phyllo sheets in the pan, brushing each with butter. Keep the rest under a damp towel.
Spread on the spinach filling, then top with 10 more buttered sheets.
Trim the edges, brush the top with butter, and score into squares with a sharp knife.
Bake until deep golden and crisp.
Cool 10 minutes, then cut along the lines.

recipes.title: Pastitsio
recipes.blurb: Baked pasta with cinnamon beef sauce and thick bechamel

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Boil the pasta 2 minutes short of done, then drain.
Brown the beef with the onion until no pink remains (160°F). Add the garlic.
Stir in tomatoes, paste, cinnamon and salt. Simmer until thick.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then whisk in the warm milk until thickened.
Off the heat, stir in half the parmesan, then the eggs.
Toss the pasta with a third of the bechamel. Spread half in a 9x13 dish, add the meat sauce, then the rest of the pasta.
Pour the remaining bechamel over the top and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until golden and set.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Gemista (stuffed tomatoes and peppers)
recipes.blurb: Tomatoes and peppers baked with herbed rice

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Slice the tops off the tomatoes and peppers and scoop out the pulp. Keep the tops and chop the pulp.
Cook the onion in 3 tablespoons oil until soft, then add the garlic and the chopped pulp.
Stir in the rice, herbs, oregano, salt and pepper. Cook 2 minutes off the heat.
Salt the hollowed vegetables inside. Fill them two-thirds full so the rice can swell.
Stand them in a deep roasting pan with the potatoes tucked around. Add the tops.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and pour 1 cup water around them.
Bake until the rice is tender and the tops are browned.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Avgolemono soup
recipes.blurb: Silky lemon-egg chicken and rice soup

steps.text: Bring the broth, chicken, onion and celery to a gentle simmer in a large pot.
Poach until the chicken reaches 165°F, then lift it out and shred.
Add the rice to the broth and simmer until tender.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy.
Slowly ladle 2 cups hot broth into the eggs while whisking so they do not scramble.
Stir the egg mixture back into the pot over low heat. Do not boil.
Add the chicken, dill, salt and pepper and warm for 2 minutes.
Serve right away; the soup thickens as it sits.

recipes.title: Fasolada
recipes.blurb: Greek white bean and tomato soup

steps.text: Cover the soaked beans with fresh water, bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oil in the pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery until soft.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and stir 1 minute.
Return the beans with the tomatoes, bay leaves, oregano and 2 quarts water.
Simmer gently with the lid slightly open until the beans are very tender.
Season with salt and pepper and remove the bay leaves.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Gigantes plaki
recipes.blurb: Giant beans baked in a sweet tomato and dill sauce

steps.text: Drain the soaked beans, cover with fresh water and simmer until just tender.
Drain, keeping 1 cup of the cooking water. Heat the oven to 375°F.
Cook the onions in the oil until golden, then add the garlic and tomato paste.
Stir in tomatoes, oregano, sugar, salt, pepper and the reserved water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Fold in the beans, dill and parsley and pour into a baking dish.
Bake uncovered until the sauce is thick and the tops are crisp.
Serve warm or at room temperature with feta and bread.

recipes.title: Briam (Greek roasted vegetables)
recipes.blurb: Potatoes, zucchini and eggplant roasted in tomato and olive oil

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Toss the potatoes, zucchini, eggplant, onion and garlic in a large roasting pan.
Add the tomatoes, oil, oregano, salt and pepper and toss until coated.
Spread level and cover with foil. Roast 40 minutes.
Remove the foil and stir. Roast until the potatoes are tender and the edges brown.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.title: Greek lemon chicken and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Roasted chicken thighs and crispy potatoes with lemon and oregano

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano, 1 tsp salt and pepper.
Toss the chicken and potatoes in the marinade in a large roasting pan, chicken skin side up.
Pour the broth around the edges of the pan.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F and the skin is golden.
Stir the potatoes in the pan juices and rest everything 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanakorizo (spinach rice)
recipes.blurb: One-pot lemony rice with spinach and dill

steps.text: Cook the onion and green onions in the oil until soft.
Add the spinach in batches and stir until it wilts.
Stir in the rice, water, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the dill and lemon juice and rest covered 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken shawarma
recipes.blurb: Spiced yogurt-marinated chicken thighs, roasted until charred

steps.text: Whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, oil, garlic, spices, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Coat the chicken in the marinade, cover and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 450°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Spread the chicken on the pan in a single layer.
Roast until charred in spots and 165°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Serve in warm pita with garlic sauce, tomatoes and pickles.

recipes.title: Baked falafel
recipes.blurb: Crisp herby chickpea fritters, baked instead of fried

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F and oil a sheet pan.
Pulse the chickpeas, herbs, onion, garlic and spices in a food processor until coarse and just holding together.
Add the flour, baking powder and 1.5 tsp salt and pulse once more.
Chill the mixture for 30 minutes.
Shape into 16 small patties and set them on the pan. Brush with oil.
Bake, flipping once, until golden and crisp.
Serve in pita or on a salad with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Mujaddara
recipes.blurb: Lentils and rice topped with deeply browned onions

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in 3 cups water until almost tender.
Meanwhile, cook the onions in 6 tablespoons oil over medium-low heat, stirring often, until deep brown and crisp at the edges.
Lift out half the onions for the top.
Add the rice, cumin, salt, pepper and 1.5 cups water to the lentils.
Cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender.
Rest covered 10 minutes.
Fluff, top with the onions and serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Lebanese red lentil soup
recipes.blurb: Velvety lemony lentil soup with cumin

steps.text: Cook the onion and carrots in the oil until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the lentils fall apart.
Blend about half the soup with an immersion blender for a creamy texture.
Stir in lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with pita.

recipes.title: Chicken tagine with olives and lemon
recipes.blurb: Moroccan braised chicken with preserved-lemon flavor

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and brown it in the oil in a Dutch oven. Set aside.
Cook the onions in the same pot until soft, then add the garlic and spices.
Return the chicken and add the broth and lemon slices.
Cover and simmer gently until the chicken is tender and 175°F inside.
Add the olives and simmer uncovered to thicken the sauce.
Top with cilantro and serve over couscous.

recipes.title: Musakhan
recipes.blurb: Palestinian sumac chicken with sweet onions on flatbread

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the chicken with half the sumac, allspice, cinnamon, salt and pepper.
Roast on a sheet pan until golden and 165°F inside.
Cook the onions in the oil with the remaining sumac and 1 tsp salt until very soft and sweet.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until golden.
Spread the onions over the pita and warm in the oven for 5 minutes.
Top with the chicken and pine nuts and serve.

recipes.title: Maqluba
recipes.blurb: Upside-down rice, chicken and vegetables

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with the onion, half the spices and 6 cups water until cooked to 165°F. Save 4 cups broth.
Salt the eggplant, then fry it in oil until golden. Drain on paper towels.
Layer tomato slices on the bottom of a large pot, then the eggplant and the chicken.
Mix the rice with the remaining spices and 1 tsp salt and spread over the top.
Pour in the hot broth to cover by 1/2 inch. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low.
Rest 15 minutes, then flip onto a large platter.
Top with toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Moroccan chickpea and spinach stew
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced chickpeas simmered in tomato

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the garlic and spices and stir 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, broth and 1/2 tsp salt.
Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Add the lemon juice and serve over couscous or rice.

recipes.title: Pork souvlaki
recipes.blurb: Lemon-oregano marinated pork skewers, grilled until charred

steps.text: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss the pork in the marinade and chill at least 2 hours.
Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes, then thread on the pork.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Grill, turning, until browned and 145°F inside.
Rest 3 minutes and serve in warm pita with tzatziki.

recipes.title: Shish tawook
recipes.blurb: Lebanese garlic-yogurt chicken skewers

steps.text: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, tomato paste, garlic, oil, spices, salt and pepper.
Coat the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Heat the grill to medium-high.
Grill, turning, until charred and 165°F inside.
Rest 3 minutes and serve with rice or pita and garlic sauce.

recipes.title: Lamb kofta
recipes.blurb: Spiced ground lamb skewers with parsley and onion

steps.text: Mix everything in a bowl with your hands until sticky.
Chill the mixture 30 minutes so it holds on the skewers.
Shape into long ovals around flat metal skewers.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Grill, turning, until browned and 160°F inside.
Serve with pita, yogurt sauce and sliced tomato.

recipes.title: Beef shish kebab
recipes.blurb: Marinated sirloin with peppers and onion

steps.text: Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Marinate the beef for 2 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Thread beef, pepper and onion alternately on skewers.
Heat the grill to high.
Grill, turning, until browned outside and 145°F for medium.
Rest 5 minutes and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Halloumi and vegetable skewers
recipes.blurb: Grilled halloumi, zucchini and peppers with lemon

steps.text: Toss the vegetables with the oil, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Thread vegetables and halloumi onto skewers.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Grill, turning, until the cheese has grill marks and the vegetables are tender.
Squeeze the lemon over the top and serve right away.

recipes.title: Lemon garlic shrimp skewers
recipes.blurb: Quick grilled shrimp with a bright herb marinade

steps.text: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss in the shrimp and marinate no more than 20 minutes.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers.
Heat the grill to high and oil the grates.
Grill until pink and opaque, about 2 minutes per side.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Oven chicken gyros
recipes.blurb: Juicy sliced chicken in pita with tzatziki

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, cumin and salt. Marinate 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F and line a sheet pan.
Roast the chicken until browned and 165°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes and slice thin.
Warm the pita and spread with tzatziki.
Fill with chicken, tomato and onion and fold up.

recipes.title: Grilled lamb chops with oregano
recipes.blurb: Greek-style paidakia, simply seasoned and charred

steps.text: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Rub over the chops and let stand 30 minutes.
Heat the grill to high.
Grill the chops 4 to 5 minutes per side to 145°F for medium.
Rest 5 minutes before serving with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Turkey kofta skewers
recipes.blurb: A lighter kofta with fresh mint and cumin

steps.text: Mix the turkey, herbs, garlic, onion, spices and salt until well combined.
Chill 30 minutes.
Shape into ovals around skewers.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Grill, turning, until browned and 165°F inside.
Serve with yogurt, pita and sliced cucumber.

recipes.title: Horiatiki (Greek village salad)
recipes.blurb: Tomato, cucumber, olives and a slab of feta

steps.text: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and pepper in a wide bowl.
Add the olives and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the oil and vinegar and pour over the vegetables.
Lay the feta slab on top.
Sprinkle with oregano and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
recipes.blurb: Parsley-heavy salad with bulgur, tomato and lemon

steps.text: Soak the bulgur in the lemon juice for 15 minutes until softened.
Wash and dry the parsley and mint very well, then chop finely.
Dice the tomatoes and slice the green onions.
Toss everything with the bulgur and its juice.
Add the oil, 1 tsp salt and pepper and toss again.
Chill 20 minutes before serving so the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Fattoush
recipes.blurb: Crunchy Lebanese salad with sumac dressing and pita chips

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the pita with 3 tablespoons oil and a pinch of salt.
Bake until golden and crisp.
Whisk the lemon juice, 1/4 cup oil, sumac and 1/2 tsp salt.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, green onions and mint with the dressing.
Add the pita chips just before serving so they stay crisp.

recipes.title: Mediterranean chickpea salad
recipes.blurb: Chickpeas, cucumber, feta and red onion in lemon dressing

steps.text: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives.
Toss well and let sit 10 minutes.
Fold in the feta and parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Mediterranean quinoa bowl
recipes.blurb: Quinoa with roasted vegetables, hummus and feta

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini, pepper, tomatoes and chickpeas with the oil and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan until browned at the edges.
Meanwhile, simmer the quinoa in the broth, covered, until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the quinoa with the lemon juice.
Divide among bowls and top with the roasted vegetables.
Add dollops of hummus and sprinkle with feta.

recipes.title: Lemon orzo salad
recipes.blurb: Chilled orzo with spinach, olives and feta

steps.text: Boil the orzo in salted water until tender, then drain.
Rinse briefly under cool water and drain well.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, zest, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the orzo, spinach, tomatoes and olives and toss.
Fold in the feta and dill.
Chill 30 minutes, then taste for salt.

recipes.title: Tuna and white bean salad
recipes.blurb: Pantry-friendly Tuscan-Greek lunch with lemon and parsley

steps.text: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add the beans, onion, tomatoes and capers and stir.
Flake in the tuna and fold gently.
Stir in the parsley.
Rest 10 minutes and serve on greens or toast.

recipes.title: Chicken gyro bowl
recipes.blurb: Rice bowl with spiced chicken, cucumber and tzatziki

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the oil, oregano, cumin, garlic powder and 1 tsp salt.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken, turning occasionally, until browned and 165°F inside.
Divide the rice among bowls.
Top with chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and feta.
Finish with a big spoonful of tzatziki.

recipes.title: Watermelon feta salad
recipes.blurb: Sweet melon, salty feta and mint with lime

steps.text: Put the watermelon and onion in a large shallow bowl.
Whisk the oil and lime juice and drizzle over.
Scatter the feta and mint on top.
Finish with plenty of pepper and serve cold.

recipes.title: Shrimp saganaki
recipes.blurb: Shrimp baked in tomato sauce, topped with melted feta

steps.text: Heat the broiler. Cook the onion in the oil in an oven-safe skillet until soft.
Add the garlic, wine, tomatoes, oregano and 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer until thick.
Nestle the shrimp into the sauce and cook until just pink.
Scatter the feta over the top.
Broil until the feta is soft and lightly browned.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Baked cod with tomatoes and olives
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod in a bright Greek-style tomato sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil in a skillet until soft.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers and oregano and simmer 5 minutes.
Season the cod with salt and pepper and nestle it into a baking dish.
Spoon the sauce over the fish.
Bake until the fish flakes and reaches 145°F.

recipes.title: Lemon dill salmon in foil
recipes.blurb: Easy salmon packets with zucchini and tomatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Tear 4 big sheets of foil.
Divide the zucchini and tomatoes among the sheets.
Set a salmon fillet on each pile and season with salt and pepper.
Top with oil, lemon juice, garlic, dill and lemon slices.
Fold the foil into sealed packets on a sheet pan.
Bake until the salmon flakes and reaches 145°F.

recipes.title: Mussels in tomato and white wine
recipes.blurb: Steamed mussels in a garlicky broth, great with bread

steps.text: Discard any mussels that stay open when tapped.
Cook the shallot and garlic in the oil in a large pot for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, wine and pepper flakes and simmer.
Add the mussels, cover and steam until the shells open.
Throw away any that did not open and stir in the parsley.
Serve in bowls with the broth and warm bread.

recipes.title: Roasted whole branzino
recipes.blurb: Crisp-skinned fish stuffed with lemon and herbs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F and oil a sheet pan.
Pat the fish dry and cut 3 slashes in each side.
Rub with oil, salt and pepper inside and out.
Stuff each cavity with lemon, thyme, parsley and garlic.
Roast until the flesh is opaque and reaches 145°F.
Rest 3 minutes, then lift fillets off the bone to serve.

recipes.title: Chermoula baked fish
recipes.blurb: Moroccan herb and spice marinade on white fish

steps.text: Blend the herbs, garlic, oil, lemon juice, spices and 1 tsp salt into a loose paste.
Coat the fish with half the chermoula and marinate 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F.
Set the fish in a baking dish.
Bake until it flakes and reaches 145°F.
Spoon the rest of the chermoula over the top to serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp and feta orzo
recipes.blurb: One-pan tomato orzo with juicy shrimp

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large deep skillet until soft.
Add the garlic and orzo and stir 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, broth, oregano and 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer, stirring now and then, until the orzo is nearly tender.
Nestle in the shrimp and cook until pink.
Top with feta and dill and serve.

recipes.title: Seared tuna with olive and caper salsa
recipes.blurb: Quick seared tuna steaks with a sharp salsa

steps.text: Mix the olives, capers, tomatoes, shallot, lemon juice, parsley and 1 tablespoon oil.
Pat the tuna dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Sear the tuna about 2 minutes per side for medium-rare, or to 145°F for well done.
Slice and spoon the salsa over.

recipes.title: Lemon garlic shrimp with white beans
recipes.blurb: Fast skillet shrimp over creamy cannellini

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth and a pinch of salt and simmer.
Mash a few beans with a spoon to thicken the sauce.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and opaque.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Classic hummus
recipes.blurb: Ultra-smooth chickpea and tahini dip

steps.text: Blend the tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute.
Add the garlic, cumin and 1 tsp salt and blend until smooth.
Add the chickpeas and blend 2 minutes, scraping the sides.
With the motor running, drizzle in ice water until fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl, make a swirl and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.blurb: Thick garlicky cucumber yogurt sauce

steps.text: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out as much water as you can in a towel.
Stir the yogurt, cucumber, garlic, oil, lemon juice and dill together.
Season with 1/2 tsp salt.
Chill at least 1 hour for the best flavor.
Serve with a drizzle of oil.

recipes.title: Baba ghanoush
recipes.blurb: Smoky roasted eggplant with tahini and lemon

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F and prick the eggplants all over with a fork.
Roast on a foil-lined sheet pan, turning once, until collapsed and charred.
Cool 10 minutes, then scoop out the flesh and drain it in a sieve.
Mash the flesh with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 1/2 tsp salt.
Spoon into a bowl and top with olive oil and parsley.

recipes.title: Whipped feta dip (tirokafteri-style)
recipes.blurb: Creamy feta with a touch of heat

steps.text: Blend the feta and yogurt until completely smooth, scraping the sides.
Add the oil, lemon juice and pepper flakes and blend again.
Taste and add pepper; it should not need salt.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with more oil.
Serve with pita, cucumbers and olives.

recipes.title: Muhammara
recipes.blurb: Roasted red pepper and walnut dip with pomegranate molasses

steps.text: Heat the broiler. Broil the peppers, turning, until blackened all over.
Cover the peppers in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel and seed them.
Pulse the walnuts, breadcrumbs, garlic and spices in a food processor.
Add the peppers, molasses, lemon juice and 1 tsp salt and blend until thick.
Stream in the oil and blend until spreadable.
Serve with pita or vegetables.

recipes.title: Greek lemon roasted potatoes
recipes.blurb: Soft inside, crisp outside, drenched in lemon and oregano

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potatoes with the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, 1.5 tsp salt and pepper in a roasting pan.
Spread them in one layer and pour the broth around.
Roast 35 minutes, then stir.
Roast until the liquid is gone and the potatoes are golden.
Serve hot with extra lemon.

recipes.title: Greek lemon rice
recipes.blurb: Fluffy rice with lemon, dill and olive oil

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, lemon juice, zest and 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender.
Rest covered 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold in the dill.

recipes.title: Homemade pita bread
recipes.blurb: Puffy skillet pita ready in under 2 hours

steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, then stir in the warm water and oil.
Knead 8 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky.
Cover and let rise until doubled.
Divide into 8 balls and roll each into a 6-inch round. Rest 15 minutes.
Heat a dry cast iron skillet over high heat.
Cook each pita 1 to 2 minutes per side until puffed with brown spots.
Stack in a towel to keep them soft.

recipes.title: Roasted cauliflower with tahini sauce
recipes.blurb: Deeply browned florets with lemony tahini drizzle

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin and 1 tsp salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, turning once, until deep brown at the edges.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and a pinch of salt until pourable.
Drizzle over the cauliflower and top with parsley.
